note: Small tileable 'pixel' decorations proven in real hideouts; `pitch` = median within-file nearest-neighbour spacing (world units) observed across data/samples/poe1/*.hideout (raw-text regex over duplicate-key JSON) = the footprint to place them at so tiles abut without blobbing. Only genuine fine pixels kept: pitch <= 5 AND used many times. Large/rare decorations (Whare Floor 32, Shoreline Fern 52, Seaweed 55, Maraketh Lantern ~32, single-instance glows) were removed because they blob in color mode. `hex` top-down colour (measured|est). Ink mode auto-selects the darkest entry (Volcanic Pebble, the known ink). Coverage gaps (no small pixel exists in the corpus): green, yellow, orange/bronze, purple only appear as large-pitch decorations and are intentionally omitted.
